T1. Historical report [NO]
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES]
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES]

Synopsis:
US Treasury Secretary Bessent announced a sustained, weekly cadence of new secondary sanctions targeting Iran under "Operation Economic Outcast," starting with banks facilitating Iranian financial flows. The pressure campaign will be extended to G20 finance ministers, demanding they sever economic ties with Iran or face secondary sanctions themselves. Bessent dismissed concerns about Chinese oil purchases from Iran, claiming port blockades have already curtailed flows significantly. The implicit endgame is full financial isolation of Iran from the dollar system.
